```lean
theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] [CategoryTheory.EnoughProjectives C] : CategoryTheory.HasProjectiveResolutions C := by
  constructor
  intro X
  let P := CategoryTheory.projectiveResolution X
  use P
  intro f
  refine' CategoryTheory.ProjectiveResolution.map f
  intro g
  refine' CategoryTheory.ProjectiveResolution.map g
  intro h
  refine' CategoryTheory.ProjectiveResolution.map h
```
